Talk/Listen/Door station buttons and monthly fees for wireless/cloud intercoms - IntercomsOnline. ButterflyMX system types - ButterflyMX summary. Reddit quotes (ybm7hq, astoria) checked verbatim in Firecrawl search excerpts at the same thread URLs; r/HomeKit 1cpie4r (Bot + Hub 2 + HomeKit) and r/TrySwitchBot 110s72x (reset reply) from excerpts.
